globalAttributes.name: data-variant
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button, a[role=button], input[type=submit|button|reset]. Button style. Leave it out for the default solid main button (black in light mode, white in dark mode). Combine with data-tone for color.

values.name: secondary
values.description: Tinted fill, no border. Second most important action.

values.name: ghost
values.description: Transparent, fill on hover. Toolbars, icon buttons, Cancel.

values.name: link
values.description: Looks like a link, keeps button semantics.

values.name: item
values.description: Full-width, multi-line list entry (message list, search results). Selected (aria-current, aria-selected or aria-pressed) gets a soft accent background. data-size="sm" makes a compact row (event chips).

globalAttributes.name: data-tone
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button, [data-badge], [data-callout], progress, any text element. Color role. Independent of data-variant. On text it sets the text color. For a custom color use style="--ts-tone: <color>" instead.

values.name: neutral
values.description: Grey. Default for secondary/outline/ghost buttons and badges.

globalAttributes.name: data-size
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button (also icon buttons), input, select, [data-avatar]. Control size relative to the current density.

globalAttributes.name: data-icon
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button, a, or any element (span) for a standalone icon. An icon by name (Lucide names). is an icon; puts it before the text; an empty is a square icon-only button and needs an aria-label. Without a value () it makes a square icon button around your own svg. The default set needs icons.css (or all.css); the Vite plugin makes every Lucide icon and your own SVG folder available.

globalAttributes.name: data-layout
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any container. Lays out the element's children. Wins over the element's own display, so it also works on label, article, fieldset, dialog. Space between children comes from data-gap, space around them from data-pad; children never get margins.

values.name: row
values.description: Horizontal row, items vertically centered. Wraps onto more lines when it runs out of space, except on button, a and label (icon + text stays on one line). Override with data-wrap.

values.name: grid
values.description: Responsive columns, each at least --ts-min wide (default 16rem). A few items keep their column width instead of stretching across the row.

values.name: split
values.description: Sidebar + content. First child is the sidebar (--ts-split, default 16rem); wraps on narrow screens.

values.name: center
values.description: Horizontally centered column with max width --ts-measure (default 72rem) and side padding.

globalAttributes.name: data-cols
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout=grid]. Exactly this many equal columns instead of responsive ones (week and month grids, a 7-day picker). Columns never wrap; use data-show to swap in another layout on phones.

globalAttributes.name: data-gap
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout]. Space between the children of a data-layout element. Default md. Together with data-pad, the only spacing controls in tinystyle.

globalAttributes.name: data-pad
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any container: page wrappers, sections, panels, rows. Padding inside the element, on all sides. Use it instead of padding in style attributes. On data-layout="center" the side padding never drops below md. Overrides a component's own padding (e.g. data-pad="sm" on an article).

globalAttributes.name: data-align
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout]. Cross-axis alignment of children (align-items).

globalAttributes.name: data-justify
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout]. Main-axis distribution of children (justify-content).

globalAttributes.name: data-self
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: a child of data-layout (stack, row, grid). Aligns this one child across the layout, overriding data-align. Typical: an "Add" button in a stack that should not stretch to full width (data-self="start").

globalAttributes.name: data-wrap
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout=row]. Whether a row wraps onto more lines. Rows wrap by default.

values.name: none
values.description: Keep everything on one line (nav items, icon + label).

globalAttributes.name: data-grow
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: a child of data-layout=row or stack. This child takes the remaining space in its row or stack (and may shrink below its content in a column, e.g. a scrolling pane). Typical: the search field in a toolbar (<input type="search" data-grow>), the input in an input + button row, the title that pushes actions to the right. It starts at --ts-grow-basis (default 8rem): with less room the row wraps and it gets its own line.

globalAttributes.name: data-scroll
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: a wrapper around wide or tall content (table, code, list pane). Scroll container. Without a value it scrolls sideways when the content is wider than the screen, instead of making the whole page scroll (wrap wide tables in it). data-scroll="y" scrolls vertically inside a fixed-height area (panes in a data-shell="fixed" app, message lists).

globalAttributes.name: data-density
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: html or any subtree. Control height and padding for everything inside.

values.name: compact
values.description: 2rem controls, smaller text. For dense apps.

globalAttributes.name: data-theme
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: html or any subtree. Forces light or dark mode. Leave it out to follow the operating system.

globalAttributes.name: data-badge
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: span. Small status label (counts, tags, states). Color with data-tone or style="--ts-tone: …".

globalAttributes.name: data-callout
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: div, [role=alert], [role=status]. Tinted message box. Put the title in <strong>. Color with data-tone (default info).

globalAttributes.name: data-muted
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any text element. Secondary text color.

globalAttributes.name: data-truncate
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any element. Single line, cut off with an ellipsis.

globalAttributes.name: data-clamp
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any text element. Cuts text off after this many lines with an ellipsis (data-truncate is the one-line version).

globalAttributes.name: data-bar
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any element, usually a data-variant="item" row or a card. A colored bar on the start edge in the element's tone. Event chips: <button data-variant="item" data-size="sm" data-bar style="--ts-tone: #4CAF50">.

globalAttributes.name: data-sr-only
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any element. Hidden visually, still read by screen readers.

globalAttributes.name: data-pairs
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: dl. Shows dt/dd pairs as a two-column label/value grid.

globalAttributes.name: data-caption
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any text element. Small, semibold, muted label text: captions above values, group headings like a letter in an index.

globalAttributes.name: data-avatar
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: span, div. Round avatar with initials, or an child that fills it. Colored by tone (default accent); size with data-size or style="--ts-avatar-size: 4rem".

globalAttributes.name: data-stretch
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: the main link or button inside an article. Makes the whole card clickable through this element. Other links and buttons in the card stay clickable. Use it on the card's title link, or on a data-variant="link" button.

globalAttributes.name: data-shell
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: body or the outermost app wrapper. App shell: a navigation rail ([data-rail]) next to <main>. On narrow screens (< 48rem) the rail becomes a drawer. Without a value the document scrolls; with data-shell="fixed" the shell fills the viewport and <main> scrolls inside it, for multi-pane apps (give inner panes data-scroll="y").

values.name: fixed
values.description: Fills the viewport; main scrolls inside it.

globalAttributes.name: data-rail
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: nav inside [data-shell]. Navigation rail. It must be a direct child of [data-shell]. Children: optional <header> (brand, collapse toggle), links/buttons or a <ul> of them, optional <footer> pinned to the bottom. Items need no attributes; mark the active one with aria-current="page" (CSS cannot detect the current page). Put item text in a <span> so it can hide when collapsed. Add the popover attribute and an id to get a drawer on narrow screens (< 48rem), opened by <button popovertarget="…" data-show="narrow">; without popover the rail stays visible on narrow screens.

globalAttributes.name: data-collapsed
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: [data-rail]. Icon-only rail, set in the markup (e.g. rendered by the server from a saved preference). For a toggle the user can click, use a data-rail-collapse checkbox instead.

globalAttributes.name: data-rail-collapse
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: input type="checkbox" inside [data-rail] (usually in its header). Collapse toggle drawn as a chevron icon button. Checked = icon-only rail. Needs an aria-label. CSS cannot remember it across page loads: render checked from a saved preference, or save it with a few lines of script.

globalAttributes.name: data-rail-label
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: any element inside [data-rail]. Hidden while the rail is collapsed (e.g. the user name in the rail footer).

globalAttributes.name: data-fab
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: button. Floating action button fixed in the bottom-right corner. Combine with data-icon and an aria-label.

globalAttributes.name: data-show
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: any element. Shows the element only on narrow (< 48rem) or wide screens.

values.name: narrow
values.description: Only below 48rem (e.g. the button that opens the drawer).

globalAttributes.name: data-menu
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (menu.css). On: [popover] (dropdown) or any container (static menu). Menu of buttons, links and checkbox labels; <hr> separates groups. On a [popover] opened via popovertarget it is placed under its button (a plain [popover] without data-menu is centered in the viewport).

globalAttributes.name: data-combo
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (menu.css). On: a wrapper around an input and its suggestion list. Combobox: the data-menu (role="listbox", options role="option", the highlighted one aria-selected="true") inside it opens under the field. Show and hide the list from script.
